label: Uneasy standoff
summary: Pressure and small openings. Washington's promised 'economic D-Day' landed: Treasury Secretary Bessent sanctioned Iran's oil, aviation, shipping and gold sectors plus 60 individuals and vessels, and pressed allies to join while the naval blockade holds. Against that, Pakistan reported 'significant progress' toward restoring the US-Iran memorandum, and Syria marked its removal from the US terror list after 47 years. Ukraine struck the Afipsky refinery; Armenia said it will open EU accession talks. Africa carried the weight: DR Congo's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak passed 100 days at 5,515 cases and 2,642 deaths, and Haitian gangs killed at least 30. Trump added 50 percent auto tariffs on Canada from 2027, and Papua New Guinea's El Nino drought deepened. Brighter: NASA cleared the Roman Space Telescope for an August 30 launch. No editorial adjustment.
